title: Cross-session turn reference capsule
description: The bounded, non-transitive capsule stored in turn_reference_capsules.capsule_json, per docs/spec/operator-session.md 10.2. It never contains the operator message, the full coordinator answer, or any transitive turn or session reference.

laneId.description: Lane of the source turn. The resolver compares it to the requesting session's lane and denies a mismatch with OPERATOR_SESSION_REFERENCE_DENIED before reading any source content.

evidenceRefs.description: Resolved evidence references and their staleness. Reference targets are named, never expanded; expanding one would make the capsule transitive.

proposals.description: Proposal IDs and types only, exactly as operator-session.md 10.2 requires. No proposal body, state rationale, or effect payload.

answerExcerpt.description: At most 500 UTF-8 bytes of the coordinator answer, truncated only on a code-point boundary. maxLength 500 is a necessary character-level bound; the byte cap is the normative rule and is enforced by the decoder and asserted by the conformance runner.

answerBytes.description: Original byte length of the complete answer, required by operator-session.md 10.2.

answerDigest.description: Digest of the complete answer, so a reader can verify exact length and content without the index holding either.

incomplete.description: True exactly when answerExcerptBytes < answerBytes. operator-session.md 10.2 requires the excerpt to be explicitly labeled incomplete when truncated; this field is that label and must equal the derivation.

omitted.description: Always states what was withheld, so truncation never silently implies completeness.

prunedContent.description: True when the source content is pruned. The capsule then resolves to its tombstone with OPERATOR_SESSION_CONTENT_PRUNED and carries no excerpt.
